Since we are busy waiting we can just avoid this logic entirely. `target_ticks` will always get set to itself here. 

A nice bonus is there is no point in tracking `current_ticks` or `target_ticks` across frames anymore

> A nice bonus is there is no point in tracking `current_ticks` or `target_ticks` across frames anymore

Don't we still want to keep track of the `target_ticks` across frames so that any time spent actually producing the frame is not added to the next frame delay?
Hmmm, yes thats right. Good point.
